producer_report.summary: I added docs/design/direct-main-landing.md and a CHANGELOG.md entry. The note describes landing each verified job's single commit directly on host main (merge_tree from the recorded base, then commit_tree, then push). It quotes 2203.6 of 2252.0 minutes and predicts a 5.0 minute saving per landed job. It says the next review compares the landing-and-rebuild minutes after the change landed with that prediction, and that an implementing change must cite review 20261110-024838-mch9. The policy scan test passes. The note also has existing-code, alternatives, risks and rollback sections.
